children: China will step up scrutiny of malicious price competition, including cost investigations and price inspections of companies that engage in such practices, according to Bloomberg.
The State Administration for Market Regulation said at a State Council Information Office briefing on Sunday that it will increase enforcement against companies involved in such pricing behavior.

title: GEOPOLITICS | China to Intensify Enforcement on Malicious Price Competition
